hey guys so a couple of days ago I did a video 
on my Channel about a build that I called the

Icebreaker it's the most fun that I've had with 
any build to date in balers Gate 3 it's basically

a character designed to deal some really solid 
damage both via their own weapon attacks and by

returning damage to enemies when the enemy hits 
them I figured I would put out just this little

gameplay snippet of how it worked along with 
like a quick highle overview for those of you

who are very familiar with the game mechanics 
and or don't have interest in watching like an

hourong deep dive the class breakdown at level 
12 is this one level of white dragon ancestry

draconic Soul sorcerer uh mostly for access to the 
armor of Agatha spell five levels of abjuration

wizard for the Arcane Ward primarily but also to 
get the fire Shield spell and then six levels of

Swords board so we can continue to enjoy full 
spellcaster spell slot progression while also

getting extra attack and the ability to hit two 
Targets in melee a few times per short rest both

to do damage to both of them but also to apply 
conditions from our weapons as for Feats we're

going to be sure and grab dual wielder so that 
we can dual wield more than just light weapons

right and also weapon master so that we can 
have Proficiency in the weapons that we want

to dual wield alternatively if you don't want 
to take weapon master and would rather take

like Elemental Adept or something else instead 
which would be nice on this build you can take

a single level dip in like Paladin or fighter 
sacrificing a level of wizard or go Valor Bard

instead of Swords barard since Valor bards 
get Marshal weapon proficiency unlike swords

bars right though you would be sacrificing a 
little burst and cleave damage for going Valor

instead as for equipment I'm not going to try 
and tell you like what the best ins slau item

is for every single potential piece of equipment 
or anything but the most important items to make

this build really work are the weapons first up 
the flail of Ages which among other things can

apply the chilled condition to enemies making 
them vulnerable to cold damage right and then

the Trident of the Waves which among other things 
applies the wet condition when you hit in combat

here's how it works first get an ally to put 
Waring Bond on you reducing the damage that

you take when you get hit then get your Arcane 
Ward Stacks maxed out and make sure you have the

highest level of armor of agius as you possibly 
can active on yourself then right before combat

breaks out cast fire Shield but the chill Shield 
version of it right on yourself and then start

the fight you're going to be running into combat 
and trying to hit as many enemies as possible at

least once to either get them wet or chilled 
thereby making them vulnerable to cold damage

that way when they hit you they will take double 
damage both from armor of agius and chill Shield

you can even intentionally provoke opportunity 
attacks from them if you want to help ensure

that they will try to hit you I didn't really do 
that in this little video but it's something that

I do regularly Lally when I'm playing this build 
best of all thanks to Arcane Ward and warding Bond

as often as not when they do hit you neither you 
nor your party member who cast Arcane Ward on you

is going to take any damage like Shadow heart 
here for example even when they do hit you it

will rarely break through the temporary hit points 
that you have from armor of agius even if an enemy

isn't wet or chilled yet they're going to die 
just by attacking you like this poor guard did

and if they are wet or chilled then yeah the 
damage that they take from just hitting you is

massive like this steel Watcher did for example 
it took 76 damage for hitting me and I took no

damage nor did Shadow heart that's freaking 
awesome now in this particular instance I got

snared uh and so I was trapped inside of the self 
D struck of the steel Watcher which kind of made

me laugh actually this other guard who was also 
in the area you know I hit him and then on his

turn he tries to run outside of the area of the 
blast but you know thinking that he had escaped

and was safe tried to make a couple of attacks 
on me unfortunately he still died anyways just

for hitting me finally and especially if you're 
just fighting a single enemy you can on your turn

hit them first with your flail in your main hand 
chilling them ideally then with your Trident as

a bonus action getting them wet and enemies who 
are first chilled then made wet become Frozen for

a round essentially incapacitating them but also 
making them vulnerable to bludgeoning damage we

can then take our second attack from our attack 
action with our flail which does bludgeoning

damage thus shattering them for a nice big chunk 
of weapon damage in the end you guys this build

is incredibly potent incredibly fun it does 
a ton of damage it's super tanky and actually

makes a great solo play build if you're looking 
for something other than a ranged swords SP uh

to solo with if you'd like a full breakdown 
with all the details of how we build and play

the character right from level one check out the 
video uh in the top right corner there and in the

video description as well so yeah thanks for 
watching and I hope you enjoy the Icebreaker
